plan.title: BLOCKER: generated project registry refresh requires coverage in a design-only consumer

narratives.Description: BLOCKER: generated project registry refresh requires coverage in a design-only consumer
narratives.Overview:
## Problem
A design-only consumer cannot finish the prescribed pre-PR workflow on published Directive 0.123.0 when `project:render` refreshes its generated story registry. The shared coverage classifier added by #5421 classifies every edit to `xbrief/PROJECT-DEFINITION.xbrief.json` as coverable configuration, including a change limited to `/plan/items` and `/xBRIEFInfo/updated`.

## Verified reproduction
1. Use a clean committed consumer diff containing Markdown design/evidence, proposed xBRIEFs, decision records, and a generated project registry refresh.
2. Verify the project-definition JSON changes only at `/plan/items` (empty array to generated scope summaries) and `/xBRIEFInfo/updated` (timestamp). Policies, runtime/build/test configuration and application source are unchanged. The consumer has no application code or coverage report yet.
3. Run `deft coverage:hotspots --json`.
4. Observe exit 2: `coverage-hotspots: coverage report missing at .../coverage/coverage-final.json`, with advice to run tests with coverage.

The installed engine/package is 0.123.0. The same unconditional `LIVE_SETTINGS_PATHS` classification is present on upstream master `da3b553f0`. Source: `packages/core/src/coverage-applicability/evaluate.ts`, `isCoverableConfig` / `classifyChangedPath`.

## Impact and alternatives
Affected flow: consumer planning PR submission. Static xBRIEF checks and `deft check` pass, but mandatory pre-PR coverage cannot finish; the commit remains local and the PR is unopened. This is an observed ship hard stop, not a predicted cost.

The documented exit-3 N/A channel cannot be used because the controller independently reclassifies the same complete diff as applicable. A free-form audit, fabricated coverage report, reduced floor, or live verifier patch would violate the existing contract. Removing the generated registry refresh merely to evade classification would leave the planning artifacts out of sync.

Triage owner: dbcall2. Date: 2026-10-08 UTC.

## Proposed bounded correction
Inspect the before/after Git blobs under the existing base/head/tree binding for a modified project-definition file. Recognize only a closed, validated generated-registry/timestamp change as inert for code coverage; leave policies, unknown fields, executable configuration and all other mixed changes subject to the current fail-closed behavior. Do not blanket-exempt the file or all xBRIEFs. Validate the registry shape so arbitrary executable settings cannot be hidden under an allowed field.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A registry/timestamp-only consumer diff can use the existing exit-3 N/A channel without an Istanbul report; the controller independently agrees for the same binding.
- Policy/configuration edits, unknown fields, malformed JSON, additions/deletions/renames without safe proof, and mixed executable diffs cannot acquire N/A through this exception.
- Add positive and negative regression tests, including the hotspots/controller consumer path and stale binding protection.
- Keep static validation, full checks, measured coverage floors and review requirements intact.
- Publish through the normal reviewed release path; verify the installed public-npm version against the consumer reproduction before resuming its PR.

Related: #5421. This is a narrower residual defect in content classification, not a request for a general docs-only bypass or a non-Istanbul executable coverage adapter.
